s1.syndrome_frame: Acute vision loss in one eye with retinal abnormalities
salient_findings: Visual loss in the left eye
Ischemic macular whitening in the left eye
Abnormal retinal capillary bed across the macula
key_facts: 2-day history of visual loss in the left eye
No dehydration or other precipitating factors noted
Visual acuity was 20/20 OD and 20/800 OS
Right eye examination was unremarkable except for peripheral retinal black sunburst lesions
Ischemic macular whitening noted in the left eye
No cherry-red spot, hemorrhage, or peripheral neovascularization present
Fluorescein angiography showed abnormal retinal capillary bed across the macula
OCT showed hyperreflective plaques at the level of the INL/OPL
OCT showed temporal macular thinning in the right eye

shortlist.label: Sickle Cell Retinopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has sickle cell disease and presents with retinal abnormalities

shortlist.label: Central Retinal Artery Occlusion
shortlist.why_kept: Patient presents with acute vision loss and ischemic macular whitening

shortlist.label: Branch Retinal Artery Occlusion
shortlist.why_kept: Patient presents with acute vision loss and abnormal retinal capillary bed

shortlist.label: Retinal Vasculitis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient presents with retinal abnormalities and potential systemic disease

shortlist.label: Ocular Ischemic Syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Patient presents with acute vision loss and retinal ischemia

raw.rationale: The patient has sickle cell disease (HbSS variant) and presents with visual loss, ischemic macular whitening, and peripheral retinal black sunburst lesions, which are characteristic findings of sickle cell retinopathy.

rejected.label: Central Retinal Artery Occlusion
rejected.why: No cherry-red spot was noted, which is a typical finding in central retinal artery occlusion.

rejected.label: Branch Retinal Artery Occlusion
rejected.why: The fluorescein angiography showed abnormal retinal capillary bed across the macula, but no evidence of a branch retinal artery occlusion was noted.

rejected.label: Retinal Vasculitis
rejected.why: There is no mention of inflammation or vasculitis in the patient's presentation or diagnostic findings.

rejected.label: Ocular Ischemic Syndrome
rejected.why: The patient's findings are more consistent with sickle cell retinopathy, and there is no evidence of carotid artery disease or other causes of ocular ischemic syndrome.

gold: Paracentral acute middle maculopathy in sickle cell disease
